reported_error: Same-origin request required, HTTP 403 on Consultation and manual AI generation after first Render deployment.
source_evidence: Adapter compares incoming Origin to new URL(request.url).origin. Installed Next 16.2.6 next-server.js attachRequestMeta builds initUrl with fetchHostname and bound port when provided (next start --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT); forwarding protocol may retain HTTPS. This can differ from public browser origin. Render terminates TLS and supplies RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL automatically.
fix: Add trusted publicOrigin dependency sourced server-side from RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL. Mutations compare Origin exactly to its validated HTTPS root; missing/foreign/opaque origins still fail. Invalid configured origins fail closed with 503. Local behavior is unchanged when unset. Request Host and forwarding headers are not consulted.
